description: Explain teamwork, leadership, and team dynamics in academic and workplace contexts, including team roles, why teamwork works, team membership, leadership challenges, the importance of leadership, leadership types, and approaches for building leadership skills.

Apply teamwork and leadership skills to complete group tasks and projects, including project launch, team charters, trust, psychological safety, group project proposals, leadership practice, proposal presentation, progress reporting, final group project reporting, and project presentation preparation.

Demonstrate effective communication in collaborative settings using emotional intelligence and meeting facilitation, including psychological safety, trust and communication, text, email, netiquette, emotional intelligence, productive expression of feelings, team meeting planning, group problem solving, conflict communication, constructive feedback.

Analyze and resolve team conflicts using problem-solving and constructive feedback strategies, including group problem solving, sources of conflict, effective communication during conflict, feedback ability, respectful feedback, positive and goal-directed feedback, collaborative feedback communication, and conflict resolution.

Produce professional written documents and deliver clear persuasive presentations for academic and workplace purposes, including text, email, netiquette, memorandums, letters, business proposals, nonverbal delivery, visual aids, persuasive presentation principles, ethical speaking, oral versus written communication, writing preparation, report writing.

Develop a personal career plan and demonstrate readiness for professional environments, including career exploration, career paths, professional skill building, career development, transferable skills, networking, CV and cover letter preparation, interviewing, mini job fair participation, employer feedback.

Demonstrate ethical and responsible communication in teamwork and professional contexts. The scope integrates trust, psychological safety, netiquette, business writing, leadership, meeting practice, conflict communication, respectful feedback, persuasive speaking ethics, plagiarism-aware writing, reliable sources, career communication, interviewing, and reflective professional communication.
